summary: Preserve AggregateError constructor ordering: message coercion, cause installation, then errors iteration.

semantics.abrupt: an earlier abrupt step prevents later steps

tests.name: message before iterator
tests.input: let s=[]; const msg={toString(){s.push('msg');return 'm'}}; const it={[Symbol.iterator](){s.push('iter');return [][Symbol.iterator]()}}; AggregateError(it,msg); console.log(s.join(','))

tests.name: cause before iterator
tests.input: let s=[]; const opt={get cause(){s.push('cause');return 1}}; const it={[Symbol.iterator](){s.push('iter');return [][Symbol.iterator]()}}; AggregateError(it,'m',opt); console.log(s.join(','))
